messages:
sam (release-council): deploybot just auto-paused the eu-central rollouts. incident looks like storage throttling. holding all non-urgent slots.
maya (sre): yep, seeing IO saturation on a couple racks. we've flipped the autoscaler to conservative.
deploybot: deploybot: Paused 4 rollouts in env=eu-central. Reason=incident-2025-02-euc-storage-throttle.
harry (platform): proposal: quarantine current canaries (freeze promotions), push remaining to next change window, allow emergency fixes with two approvals.
sam (release-council): agreed. canaries that are healthy should stay pinned to their current image; do NOT promote.
maya (sre): creating a canary lock and applying a rollback-if-spike policy.

```
# lock canaries
releasectl lock --env eu-central --group * --reason "incident-2025-02-euc" --policy rollback-if-spike
```

maya (sre): lock created id=c-lock-5721.
deploybot: Policy update: env=eu-central mode=quarantine, allow-emergency-manual=1, max-concurrent-promotions=0.
sam (release-council): requeue command for non-urgent releases — send to next-window:morning-utc. include note referencing incident and pinned canaries.

```
releasectl requeue --env eu-central --priority low --target-window morning-utc --note "requeued due to storage throttle; canaries pinned"
```

deploybot: 3 releases requeued -> morning-utc window. 1 release marked for manual emergency patch.
harry (platform): emergency patch exceptions: must pass perf-smoke and have approvals from maya + sam. also require tagging release with incident id.
sam (release-council): add release notes snippet for CS: "Releases delayed due to eu-central storage incident. Limited emergency patching allowed with approvals. Expect next window in morning UTC."
svc-notify: Notifying oncall and product about requeue.
maya (sre): monitoring for 30m. if any metric worsens we flip to full rollback and freeze. will post update here.
sam (release-council): thanks. i'll close the loop with legal and comms if this stretches past the morning window. marking this thread as incident-driven requeue + exception policy.
